extension.summary: Play Blu-ray MPLS playlists from .strm files and create them via thediscdb.com
extension.description: Plays Blu-ray/UHD MPLS playlists via plugin:// URLs in .strm files. Built-in STRM Creator with two modes: enter a thediscdb.com URL for a single disc, or enter an EAN/UPC barcode to auto-scan and process all discs in a folder. Creates .strm files organized by show and season, works with any Kodi source (NFS, SMB, WebDAV, local).

extension.summary: Unofficial Kodi video add-on for South Park.
extension.description: Browse and watch South Park episodes from the official South Park websites, with season covers, episode stills, season descriptions and premiere dates. The location setting selects the audio and metadata language, for example Germany (German) or North America (English). Episodes that come with more than one audio track show all of them in the player's audio menu. ParkStream is an independently maintained fork of plugin.video.southpark_unofficial by Giovanni Dante Grazioli (wargio).
extension.disclaimer: ParkStream is unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by South Park Studios, Comedy Central or Paramount. South Park and all related titles, characters and artwork are trademarks and copyrights of their respective owners. Episode availability depends on your location. Check your local laws before use.
extension.news: 1.0.2 - Removed inputstream.adaptive completely; ParkStream plays HLS streams through Kodi's own player

extension.summary: Free films, TV shows and live channels from Tubi
extension.description: Tubi has a large library of free, ad-supported films, TV shows and live channels. Unofficial add-on, not affiliated with Tubi. * Home, Movies, TV Shows, Search and a Live TV guide in the add-on's own interface * Series with their seasons and episodes * Live TV guide from Tubi's own programme data, plus IPTV Manager integration for the Kodi TV guide * Context menu: add to the library, related titles, trailers, and with an account My List, like and dislike * Resume from Tubi's watch history * Optional Tubi account sign-in * Add films and shows to the Kodi library as .strm files * Add-on-local direct/custom network routing with a GeoTV media relay * PseudoTV Live support
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tubi. Tubi streams only in the countries it serves. Encrypted titles need a working Widevine CDM for InputStream Adaptive.
extension.news: 2026.10.13.1 - Trakt compatibility - NEW: Films and episodes tell Kodi their title, year, series, season and episode, so Kodi's Trakt add-on can scrobble them. Live TV and trailers are excluded. Trakt stays optional; nothing else changes. 2026.10.13 - The add-on's own interface - NEW: Home, Movies, TV Shows, Series, Search and a Live TV guide in the add-on's own interface, with a loading screen and a navigation bar. - NEW: Live TV guide from Tubi's programme data: categories, channel logos, a half-hour timeline, the current time and programme progress. - NEW: Context menu on films and series: library export, related titles, trailer, My List, like and dislike. - NEW: Resume from Tubi's watch history in the new interface. - CHANGED: Encrypted titles go to InputStream Adaptive without a check for a Linux Widevine file or a minimum CDM version, so Android, Windows and macOS can play them. Only a CDM that would crash Kodi is refused. - FIXED: Clearing or changing the account credentials ends the previous sign-in, also when signing in with the new ones fails. - FIXED: Series and Live TV stop waiting after 20 seconds when Tubi cannot be reached; Back cancels the loading screen. Earlier changes are in the add-on's source history.

extension.summary: Automatically adds extra artwork for your media.
extension.description: Artwork Beef automatically adds extra artwork for TV shows and movies into your library. It grabs them from wonderful web services and the file system.
extension.disclaimer: Artwork sources: fanart.tv, TheTVDB.com, The Movie Database, TheAudioDB, KyraDB
extension.summary: Agrega automáticamente ilustraciones adicionales para sus medios.
extension.description: Artwork Beef agrega automáticamente ilustraciones adicionales para Series TV y Películas a su biblioteca. Las ilustraciones son agregadas desde Servicios web y el Sistema de archivos local.
extension.disclaimer: Fuente para ilustraciones: fanart.tv, TheTVDB.com, The Movie Database, TheAudioDB, KyraDB
extension.news: v0.28.10 (2026-05-17) - Fix: AttributeError 'xbmcgui.ListItem' object has no attribute 'getfilename' when manually selecting artwork in the Artwork Beef dialog on Kodi 19+. The removed API getfilename() is replaced by getPath() (symmetric to the existing setPath() calls) in lib/artworkselection.py and context.py. v0.28.9 (2026-05-16) - Fix: TypeError when sorting images by language on Python 3 (Kodi 19+). image['language'] can be None for some providers, which broke tuple sorting against str values. Now None is normalised to empty string. v0.28.8 (2026-05-16) - Fix: replace deprecated StorageServer (script.common.plugin.cache) cache backend with script.module.simplecache. The legacy addon is no longer distributed in Kodi repos and prevented Artwork Beef from starting on fresh installs. v0.28.7 (2026-05-16) - Fix: remove unused script.module.simplejson and script.common.plugin.cache requirements that prevented installation on Kodi 22 (Piers) v0.28.6 (2025-12-12) - Kodi Omega (v21) compatibility - Python 3 migration (all Python 2 syntax updated) v0.28.5 (2020-11-26) - fix: really really treat 403 as 404 and replace it v0.28.4 (2020-11-21) - fix: 403 change causing errors with other web service issues v0.28.1 - v0.28.3 - fix: treat 403 as 404 and replace it - fix: don't throw an error when a movie set is lost - Fix: avoid adding duplicate fanart from TVDB - Fix: log full URL when download fails - Fix: remove KyraDB v0.28.0 (2020-02-08) - Feature: Add "Path exclusion" settings to skip processing media items by path
